name: Aye Dil Aazma Nahin
overview: Aye Dil Aazma Nahin explores the intense rivalry between step-sisters, where love, jealousy, and deep-rooted insecurities collide. Shaped by maternal bias and complicated relationships, their journey unfolds into a powerful tale of emotions, choices, and consequences. As tensions rise, every bond is tested, revealing how far one can go when the heart is pushed to its limits. Will love heal the wounds… or make them deeper?
